name: http
displayName: Perception in Microsoft Graph - HTTP examples
description: Language-neutral HTTP recipes for session filtering, report retrieval, and playbook execution.

inputs.name: graphBaseUrl
inputs.description: Tenant-enabled Microsoft Graph agentic security base URL; see the example setup.

inputs.name: accessToken
inputs.description: Delegated Microsoft Graph token for the selected operation; configure only in the HTTP client's local authentication settings.

inputs.name: userId
inputs.description: Microsoft Entra user object ID used for client-side initiator matching.

inputs.name: sessionId
inputs.description: Returned session ID required for session-specific reads or cancellation.

inputs.name: playbookDefinitionId
inputs.description: Catalog definition ID required for creating a session; verify its accepted inputs.

inputs.name: outputId
inputs.description: Opaque output ID returned for the selected session, required for output metadata and content reads.

inputs.name: inputValue
inputs.description: Authorized incident, alert, threat intelligence article, or subscription ID required by the selected playbook; zero-input playbooks use an empty inputs array.
